text.p: Mexico's Grupo Financiero Inbursa SA earned a net profit of 3.484 billion pesos during 1996, up 8.0 percent compared with 1995 profits, the company said in a statement.
It said its bank unit Banco Inbursa earned net profits of 1.236 billion pesos, up 15.2 percent compared with the previous year.
Provisions against bad loans reached 339 million pesos, while net capital was 5.629 billion, a figure the company said placed it in fourth place among Mexican banks.
Profits at its insurance division were 1.345 billion pesos, up 25.6 percent from 1995. The group's investment bank unit earned 174 million pesos during 1996, up 8.7 percent from 1995.
